shared_elements: standing human figures in profile/frontal rows
figures holding elongated objects (staffs, weapons, spears)
groups of figures arranged in a procession-like line
justification: Both surfaces show multiple upright human figures carrying long linear implements and both include a prominent circular element (a spoked wheel in B, a large ring beside a figure in A), but these are generic and could arise independently. The manner of depiction is utterly different: A uses extremely schematic stick-like bodies with disproportionate calves and abstract cup/boat signs, while B renders modelled, naturalistic bearded men, horses, chariot and detailed drapery in a single narrative frieze; A also lacks any animals or vehicles.
